degenerate_curve_policy: if DeltaV <= gap_epsilon, useful-rank targets are undefined (NaN)

notation.best: Vmin = min_r V(r) over the tested rank grid

oracle_policy: oracle_val_loss is diagnostic only and cannot affect empirical useful-rank targets

targets.near_best: min r such that V(r) <= Vmin + gamma * DeltaV
targets.penalized: argmin_r V(r) + lambda * DeltaV * r / rmax
targets.recovery: min r such that (V0 - V(r)) / DeltaV >= rho
